blocks.summary: Schemes — The Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Rurban Mission (SPMRM):

items: Launched on 16th September 2015 by the Ministry of Rural Development, aims to bridge the rural-
urban divide by developing rural areas with urban amenities and services.
Cluster-based development of 300 rural clusters, focusing on both plain coastal areas (25,000-
Investment attraction through clusters, fostering economic growth and employment.
Employment generation and poverty alleviation through rural development, infrastructure
Integrated rural development with urban-like facilities (roads, water, sanitation, electricity).
Sustainable development with an emphasis on green solutions and local resources.
By creating better infrastructure and job opportunities, the mission strives to reduce migration,
increase rural prosperity, and promote balanced growth across India.
